title: Fibonacci sequence
prompt: Create main.py that prints exactly the first 10 Fibonacci numbers starting with 0 and 1, separated by spaces, on one line. Standard library only, no dependencies, no input or networking.

title: CSV quality audit
prompt:
Create a Python CSV quality checker in main.py using only the standard library. Use this inline CSV: id,name,email
1,Ada,ada@example.com
2,Sam,
2,Sam,sam@example.com
3,,lee@example.com
. Count data rows, duplicate IDs beyond their first occurrence, and blank cells across all columns. Print exactly three lines: Rows: 4 then Duplicate IDs: 1 then Missing cells: 2. No user input, dependencies, networking or external files.

title: Multi-file log analyser
prompt: Create a two-file Python project with main.py importing summarize from analyzer.py. Use only standard library. In main.py use the inline log lines: INFO started; ERROR timeout; WARN retry; ERROR database; INFO recovered. Pass a list of those five strings to summarize, which returns counts by the first word. Print exactly three lines in this order: INFO: 2 then WARN: 1 then ERROR: 2. No user input, dependencies, networking or external files.

title: Repair an average calculation
prompt: Create main.py that repairs this bug: def average(values): return sum(values) // len(values). Use division preserving fractions and return 0.0 for an empty list. Include assertions that average([1,2]) == 1.5 and average([]) == 0.0. Print exactly Average: 1.5. Standard library only; no input, networking or dependencies.

title: Group transaction totals
prompt: Create main.py using only standard library. Given [('books',12),('food',8),('books',5),('food',2)], sum amounts by category and print exactly two lines alphabetically: books: 17 then food: 10. Include an assertion that totals sum to 27. No input, dependencies or networking.
